He holds a translucent dark water bottle in his right hand. The environment is brightly lit by natural sunlight, creating sharp shadows on the stone and ground. (2) He extends his arm to place the open mouth of the water bottle directly under a metal pipe spout protruding from the side of the fountain wall. Clear water streams steadily into the bottle. In the background, pedestrians walk past lush green trees and historical-style buildings in a public plaza. (3) The man raises the filled bottle to his mouth and takes several large gulps while looking away from the camera. Behind him, a woman in a blue patterned dress leans over the fountain basin to splash water on her face, and a man in a white tank top stands nearby. (4) The man turns his head toward the camera lens, revealing a wide smile and a light beard. He has a black electronic device draped around his neck. The camera moves in for a close-up of his face and the upper portion of his shirt, highlighting his expression of satisfaction.
